presentation.summary: Choose Apple TV artwork in Silo's image picker.
presentation.description_markdown: Movie and series posters, backdrops, logos and exact-season posters from Apple's public catalogue. Textless classifications are inferred from Apple image fields. Requires image_picker_lookup_provider_ids support in Silo.
presentation.setup_markdown: Save your English artwork country, test the connection and enable Apple TV Artwork in your movie, series and season provider priorities. Open Edit Metadata > Images on a TMDB-matched title to select artwork. No Apple account is required.

fields.label: English artwork country
fields.description: Two-letter country code, such as au, us or gb. Defaults to Australia.
